meta.title: Daily secretary
meta.description: Records the screen through scrabber and turns those screenshots into a verbose work diary, plus one short daily piece. A round always-on-top dot sits on the desktop: it starts PAUSED when the plugin is enabled and captures nothing until you click it, and clicking again pauses it. Green means recording, yellow means paused, and the glyph in the dot shows what a click will do; double-click the dot to read today's card. Recording runs the scrabber executable from this plugin's bin/ directory (install it with `node scripts/install-scrabber.mjs <path>`), every 20 seconds by default, into screenshots/ inside this plugin's own directory. At the end of every recording window (1 hour by default, or the first of pause, midnight, and a fresh start after a crash) the plugin sends up to 8 screenshots of that window to the model DSH currently selects, together with a timeline, and appends a detailed entry to diary/detail/<date>.md; each entry is delimited by `===============<date> <time>===============`. At the configured daily time (21:30 by default) the day's highlights become a short piece in diary/daily/<date>.md, which the dot morphs into a scrolling card to show; only the daily schedule or a manual refresh opens that card, a background refresh never does. Three settings — the recording cadence, the daily card time, and the summarising model — are edited in DSH under Settings → Daily secretary and apply as soon as they are saved, with no configuration file to touch; they can also be written in the plugin's config as defaults. The model must be one DSH has registered, an empty choice follows the profile's current model, and both the page and the startup log report whether it accepts images. Once an entry is written, the screenshots it covered are deleted, and only files the plugin can prove it created itself: a regular file, one level inside screenshots/, inside a date directory, named exactly like a scrabber capture, with the name and directory agreeing. Everything else is kept and reported. Screenshots and diary text go to the model provider the profile already uses, so this plugin costs vision tokens roughly once per hour; turn the plugin off to stop recording and deleting. The desktop dot needs a native binary: build it once with `node scripts/build-native.mjs` (Rust toolchain). Limitations: scrabber captures the primary monitor only, the schedule assumes the Harness stays open (otherwise the next start summarises the gap in one pass), and a model route without image input degrades to a timeline-only record.
